name: Hardware-wallet seed backup: standard vs Shamir + metal storage
goal: Create an offline hardware-wallet recovery backup: choose standard 12/24-word seed vs Shamir multi-share threshold, write shares correctly offline, store separately, optionally migrate to fire/water-resistant metal media.

source.title: How to backup your bitcoin hardware wallet

prerequisites: Hardware wallet (Shamir needs a model that supports it)
Pen + paper cards or metal kit
constraints: Educational self-custody/tax procedure only — not financial advice; no coin tips or return promises.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; portable UI names OK when vendor chrome drifts.
Never digitize a seed phrase or enter it into a website/phone camera.

steps.action: In setup/backup menu choose standard recovery seed OR Shamir backup if the device supports it.
Standard path: write 12/18/24 words in order on the included paper cards.
Shamir path: generate multiple unique shares and set a threshold (example 3 shares, any 2 required); write each share fully.
Enforce write rules: correct spelling, correct order, no digital copies, keep away from other people.
Store a standard seed in a safe/hidden place; for Shamir, split shares across locations (also helps inheritance planning).
steps.expect: No single loss reveals spend authority

steps.action: Optional: punch/stamp words onto metal backup (plate, tile cassette, or dual capsule that can hold multiple Shamir shares).
